tweets.text: Yesterday, Deputy Commissioner Ron Vitiello joined @dhsgov Deputy Secretary Troy Edgar and USBP’s Jason E. Schneider in Brownsville, TX to see firsthand the transformation at the southern border. New surveillance technology, maritime barriers, and reinforced border wall infrastructure are strengthening security—but the greatest asset remains our workforce. Thanks to their dedication, illegal apprehensions in the Brownsville region are down 99% from just two years ago.
